note: Integers are decimal strings because JSON has no integer type wide enough. Vectors are self-contained VerifyRequests.

vectors.description: A backed representation from an approved issuer, at the reference price, within every bound.
Synthetic exposure, explicitly permitted by the mandate.
Trading halted, with a mandate that explicitly allows execution while halted.
The candidate names a different canonical asset than the mandate authorizes.
The representation is issued against a different underlying.
The representation is not in trusted state at all: an injected or hallucinated address.
The candidate misdescribes the issuer of the representation it names.
The representation issuer is outside the mandate allowlist.
The execution chain is outside the mandate allowlist.
The execution venue is outside the mandate allowlist.
Synthetic exposure offered against a mandate that forbids it. The headline refusal.
Synthetic status could not be established; an unknown constrained field fails closed.
Ten times the authorized quantity, honestly priced. Exceeds the maximum notional.
One atom over the maximum notional.
Exactly at the maximum notional. Permitted.
Declared notional is ten times quantity times price, but still inside the mandate limit, so only the consistency check catches it.
Exactly 40 bps from the reference, with a 40 bps bound. Permitted.
One atom beyond the 40 bps bound; deviation rounds up, so it is refused.
The reference price observation is one second past the freshness bound.
The observation is timestamped after the evaluation instant; freshness cannot be established.
The underlying is halted and the mandate forbids execution while halted.
Halt status could not be established.
The representation is issuer-paused.
The representation is deprecated.
A corporate action has advanced the epoch past the one the mandate was authorized under. Reauthorization required.
The epoch feed is behind the authorization: inconsistent, not changed.
The epoch could not be established.
Epoch matches, but the observation is older than the corporate-action freshness bound.
The candidate was constructed against a different epoch than the one observed.
Evaluated exactly at expiry. Expiry is exclusive: this rejects.
Evaluated one second before expiry. Permitted.
Evaluated one second before the not-before time.
Evaluated exactly at the not-before time. Permitted.
The envelope claims the principal signed; the bytes were produced by another key.
A valid signature by a party that is not the principal: unauthorized, not invalid.
A signature issued for a different EIP-712 domain.
An authorization scheme this verifier does not implement.
The proposing agent is not the agent the mandate authorizes.
The mandate has already been consumed.
The mandate is reserved by an in-flight attempt.
Replay state could not be established; it fails closed rather than defaulting to unused.
The replay record is about a different mandate, so it establishes nothing about this one.
Notional denominated in a currency the mandate does not bound. No implicit conversion.
The execution price is quoted per a different unit than the quantity.
Quantity at a different decimal scale, with the notional restated consistently. Permitted: scale is explicit, not implied.
An identifier outside the canonical charset. Never repaired.
An identifier with a trailing separator.
A mandate schema version this verifier does not implement.
Trusted state that is structurally wrong.
A negative quantity, which is not representable.
Market state carrying advisory provenance cannot satisfy a trusted input.
Market state carrying untrusted provenance.
Required trusted state absent entirely.
Maximum uint64 nonce and corporate-action epoch, maximum uint16 deviation bound.
The maximum supported decimal scale (38) with very large atom counts, exercising exact bigint arithmetic on the permitted path.
An atom count one above the uint256 maximum, which must not wrap.
Four independent violations at once. All must be reported, not just the first.
BUY at the signed maximum total debit exactly: notional plus fees equals the limit.
BUY one atom of fee past the signed maximum total debit.
SELL at the signed minimum total credit exactly: notional minus fees equals the floor.
SELL one atom of fee below the signed minimum total credit.
SELL whose fees equal the notional: a net debit, refused before any credit comparison.
A fee denominated in a unit the notional does not use.
A contract on a chain the mandate forbids, presented with an allowed chain in the field beside it.
A candidate whose chain field disagrees with the chain inside its own representation identifier.
A candidate committing to a trusted-state digest that is not the digest of the state supplied.
An authorization quarantined after a reservation lapsed with its outcome unestablished.
